note: No map coverage. hsr-layout-08220 is one of the five slice listings whose nearest_park row is null (with hsr-layout-08112, -08134, -08145 and whitefield-05019), so render_gaps emits 'No park found in the map data within the search radius.' What must not appear is a park DISTANCE or walking TIME, which the map data does not have: must_not_match is that shape — a number and a unit within one clause of the word park, either order. Until 2026-09-15 the forbidden phrase was 'nearest park is', and a correct denial ('the distance to the nearest park isn't available') contained it as a substring; the shape of an invented fact, not its opening words, is what the probe is for. Agara Lake is deliberately NOT forbidden: it is named in the HSR Layout guide, so citing it is legitimate. 'park within' stays as a plain phrase.
